summary: Phase 3 retest after ingress-routing fix. All 5 originally failing/target endpoints now PASS against public URL https://ciber-educativo.preview.emergentagent.com. Test suite: 34/36 pytest cases PASS. The 2 remaining failures are pre-existing, unrelated to this fix (see notes). Specifically verified: (1) GET /api/verify/HS-BAD-ID → 200 text/html + contains 'Certificado no encontrado'. (2) GET /api/verify/HS-B37E6ED7 → 200 text/html + contains 'Certificado válido', 'Estudiante Prueba', 'Contraseñas seguras'. (3) GET /api/join?code=DEMO-001 → 200 text/html + mentions DEMO-001. (4) GET /api/join → 200 generic landing HTML. (5) GET /api/schools/DEMO-001/poster.png → 200 image/png, 98129 bytes, 1080x1920. (6) GET /api/seasons/leaderboard → 200 with top_schools sorted desc by avg_xp_per_active_student, rank starts at 1, all required keys present. (7) Phase-2 regression: all 15/17 pass (2 flaky failures pre-existing). Code inspection confirms `verify_url = f"{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/api/verify/{cert_id}"` (server.py:653) and `share_url = f"{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/api/join?code={code.upper()}"` (server.py:967) — both QR builders now emit ingress-reachable URLs. Both routes are registered on the /api router (@api.get at server.py:874 and 976). Dead-code cleanup in season_leaderboard verified (still lines 1044-1045 aggregate but kept for future use). No regressions detected.

minor.issue: test_game_complete_fraude asserts u['xp'] == base_xp + 30 but got 320 vs 260+30=290. Pre-existing test-order/parallel-worker race (pytest-xdist gw0/gw1 both touch the same student user); NOT a regression from this fix. Backend logic itself is correct (XP=score*6=30 for score=5).

test_chatbot_spanish_reply overly-strict: bans substring 'curp' but the LLM used it in an educational anti-pattern context ('no uses tu CURP como contraseña'). Not asking for personal data. Pre-existing, not related to Phase-3 fix.
Returns HTTP 200 with {valid:false} for unknown cert_id (spec-intended but breaks CDN 404 semantics). Carried over from iteration_3.

rca_of_issue: Root cause was that /verify and /join were mounted on the raw `app` object without the /api prefix, so K8s ingress forwarded those paths to Expo (port 3000) instead of FastAPI (port 8001). Fix (verified in iteration 4): both endpoints moved onto the /api APIRouter (server.py:874 @api.get('/verify/{cert_id}'), server.py:976 @api.get('/join')), and both QR URL builders updated to include the /api prefix (server.py:653 verify_url, server.py:967 share_url). Confirmed reachable publicly via curl against ciber-educativo.preview.emergentagent.com for /api/verify/HS-BAD-ID, /api/verify/HS-B37E6ED7, /api/join, /api/join?code=DEMO-001.
